validator-fix-7

Docs-only review · fix/val-doc-1 → task/validator-fix-7 · commit b2b36a6

TL;DR

No behavior changed. The getLookbackFloorBlock docstring now records the settled choice to use only the protocol sync window as the log-search bound, without adding the cold-start backlog. The nearby speculative author comment was removed.

What changed

  • The documentation names the bound explicitly: 
    sequencerDelayLimit + epochPeriod
  • It says this is a settled decision rather than an open question: getLookbackFloorBlock remains a bounded on-chain fast path, while the indexer is the fallback.
  • It preserves the performance rationale: broadening this floor for cold start would make an empty backward scan especially expensive—about 2.4 million blocks on Arbitrum according to the docstring—before falling back anyway.
  • It distinguishes responsibilities: setEpochRange still includes COLD_START_BACKLOG_SECS; that backlog does not belong in the latest-event lookup floor.
  • The implementation, signatures, imports, and tests are untouched. The diff is confined to comments in validator-cli/src/utils/epochHandler.ts (10 insertions, 7 deletions).

Review verdict

Approve. The change matches F7: it removes the inline question and turns the existing rationale into clear API-adjacent documentation without altering runtime behavior. The contrast with setEpochRange reduces the risk that a future maintainer applies the cold-start backlog to the wrong mechanism.

Verification scope: inspected the three-dot diff from the stated base to head and the surrounding call sites. No test run is necessary for this comment-only change.
